title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Arrives to Netflix Worldwide on July 22
content: Netflix will officially begin streaming JUJUTSU KAISEN: The Culling Game Part 1 (Season 3) worldwide on July 22. The first part of the arc aired in Winter 2026 in Japan, with Crunchyroll simulcasting it globally. Part 2, The Culling Game Part 2 (Season 4) is currently in production .
author: Anime Corner

title: 20th Anniversary Sgt. Frog Film Opens at #4, 2026 Anpanman Film at #5
content: Kiyoshi Kurosawa 's live-action film adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's The Samurai and the Prisoner ( Kokurōjō ) samurai historical mystery novel dropped from #2 to #3 in its second weekend. The film sold 108,000 tickets and earned 151,785,820 yen (about US$933,800) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Monogatari Reveals Visual and Release Date for Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre New Episode
content: Monogatari Series: Off & Monster Season anime is officially continuing with a brand new episode Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre . The episode is set to premiere next winter. The new installment will focus on Karen Araragi, who is now a first-year high school student.
author: Anime Corner

title: Monogatari Off & Monster Season Anime's New Episode Debuts in Winter
content: Aniplex revealed a new visual and the winter 2026 broadcast for the upcoming " Wazamonogatari : Karen Ogre" episode of the MONOGATARI Series: OFF & MONSTER Season anime on Thursday. Franchise veteran Akiyuki Simbo is again serving as chief director and Midori Yoshizawa is directing the new episode at SHAFT .
author: ANN

title: Round1 Launches First Simultaneous United States-Japan One Piece Collaboration in 159 Locations
content: Round1 has announced its first-ever simultaneous ONE PIECE collaboration across Japan and the United States, with the limited-time campaign running from July 18 through October 17, 2026 at 159 participating locations, including 100 venues in Japan and 59 in the U.S.
author: Anime Corner

title: Koei Tecmo's Attack on Titan 3 Game Reveals Winter Release in Gameplay Video
content: Koei Tecmo America announced in a new trailer for its Attack on Titan 3 game on Wednesday the game will debut this winter. MAPPA will produce the opening sequence, which the game will add in a later update.
author: ANN

title: The World Is Dancing Anime Gets Special Illustration by Slam Dunk, Vagabond Creator Takehiko Inoue, Reveals Opening Video
content: The World Is Dancing anime is celebrating its debut by releasing the opening video and a special illustration from the acclaimed manga creator Takehiko Inoue. Inoue, best known for Slam Dunk and Vagabond , shared a congratulatory illustration of protagonist Oniyasha with a message celebrating the anime adaptation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Street Fighter 6 Game Introduces 'Yasmine Arrives! Fighting Pass' in Video
content: The official Street Fighter YouTube channel streamed a new video on Wednesday for DLC character Yasmine's "Yasmine Arrives! Fighting Pass" and the other bonuses included in the pass.
author: ANN
